scientific_integrity: Uniform geometric proof using the projective dimension theorem, Bézout, Bertini and nondegenerate local Hessians; finite exact symbolic tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The threshold concerns one fixed balanced squarefree hypersurface Gröbner cell over C; not arbitrary squarefree ideals. The nodal count is generic. Historical priority is provisional; no independent proof audit.
title: Sharp smoothability threshold and nodal boundary for a squarefree hypersurface Gröbner cell
